pages.text: You came back. Good. Now stay here. I know what you saw down there, and I know how it called to you. The light, the warm air, the feeling that the world is breathing with you. It feels like a gift. It is not a gift. This place keeps what it is given, and it has been given so much already. Every step you take down there is a step it remembers. That little shifter in your hand opens a door in both directions, and not everything that passes through it is you. If you cross again, you cross on your own account. I will not ask twice.
